author: Nielsen, Uiblein & Mincarone, 2009

note.en: A 14 cm deep-water cusk-eel from 102 to 770 m, a record only; no diver or hand-line fisher reaches it.
note.es: Un congrio de aguas profundas de 14 cm, de 102 a 770 m, solo un registro; ningún buzo o pescador de cordel lo alcanza.

evidence: FishBase lists it for Costa Rica and the Western Central Atlantic; deep-water trawl species
recWhy: Deep-water fish with only a FishBase listing for Costa Rica.

marks.en: Slim cusk-eel with a row of dark ringed eyespots on the dorsal fin.
marks.es: Brótula delgada con una hilera de ocelos oscuros con anillo en la aleta dorsal.
